remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated home nestled in a desirable Mid Ridges neighborhood. With two spacious bedrooms and 1.5 baths this home offers the perfect blend of comfort and style. The open floor plan invites natural light into the living area, complete with a cozy wood burning fireplace, making it ideal for relaxing or entertaining guests.  The heart of the home is the wonderful updated kitchen featuring granite countertops, modern stainless steel appliances and tile floor. Whether you are preparing meals for the family or hosting friends, this kitchen is sure to impress. Enjoy the outdoors from the screened-in porch or take advantage of the fully fenced rear yard - perfect for pets, play or privacy. The exterior was recently painted and new gutters added. Conveniently located on a quiet cul-de-sac this home offers a peaceful retreat while still being close to all the amenities you need. Oil heating and central air conditioning ensure year-round comfort. Don't miss the opportunity to make this delightful home yours.
